title: The Kites That Would Not Rise
central_conflict: every kite at the festival dipped toward the same field
decisive_choice: a line of tall trees blocked the steady wind
resolution: moved the launch area to an open meadow and adjusted the tails
story_beats: At the snowy meadow, rabbit and fox discovered every kite at the festival dipped toward the same field before the library opened, leaving the visiting readers waiting.
Rabbit attempted an immediate fix, but they lengthened the strings but the kites still lost lift; fox stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Fox examined the evidence and realized a line of tall trees blocked the steady wind; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the visiting readers watching, they moved the launch area to an open meadow and adjusted the tails, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

resolution: secured the pipe and confirmed the warning system still worked

title: The Frosted Greenhouse Corner
central_conflict: one corner of the greenhouse froze despite the heater running
decisive_choice: a cracked vent let cold air blow directly onto the seedlings
resolution: sealed the vent and moved the seedlings until temperatures stabilized
story_beats: At the snowy meadow, rabbit and fox discovered one corner of the greenhouse froze despite the heater running before the library opened, leaving the visiting readers waiting.
Rabbit attempted an immediate fix, but they increased the temperature but only the center grew warmer; fox stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Fox examined the evidence and realized a cracked vent let cold air blow directly onto the seedlings; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the visiting readers watching, they sealed the vent and moved the seedlings until temperatures stabilized, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.
